text:
anna_csm: Heads-up — MonarchHealth renewal shows 42% usage drop and NPS from last call is 5. Renewal in 18 days. Need rapid intercept. :chart_with_downwards_trend:

jason_pm: Can we get a quick health snapshot? key workflows failing? any prod regressions?

mike_data: Pulling metrics now — will post 5-min snapshot. Likely cadence/embedding calls down 60%.

lila_support: They've filed 2 urgent tickets about slow inference on long prompts. Ticket IDs #MH-412, #MH-415.

sara_success_ops: Proposed immediate steps: 1) 30-min alignment call with CSM+PM+Eng 2) Offer targeted enablement workshop 3) Short-term credits + feature-flag rollback if needed

anna_csm: Agree. I'll ask for the 30-min today. Drafting targeted agenda: technical blockers, usage patterns, value gaps, quick wins.

jason_pm: I'll join. Tom from eng for debug. @tom_eng can you spare 30m at 3pm PT?

tom_eng: Can do 3pm. Will bring root-cause ideas and a patch plan. Also need logs and reproducer.

mike_data: Snapshot: last 7 days request latency median +120ms, error rate +1.8%. I'll attach chart here: <link>

lila_support: I'll compile recent customer messages and ticket notes. Also recommend we capture feedback via short form post-call.

anna_csm: Email template for pre-call invite (quick ask):
```
Hi Team,

We saw a drop in usage and want to align on how we can help recover value. Can you join a 30-min sync today at 3pm PT? We'll bring PM/Eng/CS and a remediation plan.

Thanks,
Anna
```

sara_success_ops: For retention actions: offer 60-day onboarding reprioritization + 10% credit if we can't restore baseline in 7 days. Document as "intercept wedge".

jason_pm: Also let's map downgrade-safe options in case they prefer lower tier. Need to outline what functionality remains and migration steps.

tom_eng: If patch needed, we can cut a hotfix branch and can do canary deploy within 6 hours. Need test vector. Will coordinate with eng-oncall.

retain-bot: Reminder set: sync-meeting scheduled 3pm PT today. Calendar invites sent to: anna_csm, jason_pm, lila_support, tom_eng, mike_data, monarch_contacts

anna_csm: Post-call actions owner list: Mike -> data/deep-dive, Lila -> ticket escalation/responses, Tom -> patch timeline, Jason -> downgrade options doc, Sara -> credit/ops checkbox. I'll own customer cadence and follow-up.

jason_pm: I'll draft downgrade doc and a short migration checklist by EOD.

mike_data: Posting the 5-min snapshot link: <internal-dashboard/monarch/usage-1795554321>

anna_csm: Great. Let's treat this as high-priority save wedge. Updates in thread only. :thumbsup:
